subject: AI Leaders Dinner - 29 May - Aerlume
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your AI dashcam for road safety. Our founder [SENDER]
is hosting a small dinner with AI Leaders in Seattle at the end of this
month, and was wondering if you're available to join?

We've reserved a private dining room at Aerlume on Thursday 29 May evening
(6:30 - 9:30pm) for 30 guests. Attendees include Executives & Heads of AI
from Snap, Brinc Drones & Carbon Robotics.

In case you're not familiar with Encord -- we're a computer vision data
development platform built to help teams accelerate their model
development. We work with over 200 AI teams including Woven by Toyota,
Motive, Nauto, etc.

Happy to share more details if you're interested in joining?

subject: MoshiVis and other Multimodal models
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Have been following the [COMPANY] team for some time now & noticed the recent MoshiVis VSM model release / current hiring for a vision team lead, so thought I'd reach out to introduce myself.

I lead the Multimodal team here at Encord and we've been working with several similar frontier AI teams (inc. Thinking Machines, H company, Figure AI) focusing on consolidating multimodal AI data curation, visualisation and HITL verification flows to accelerate the fine-tuning of their Multimodal models.

Curious to know if this is something you are open to explore at [COMPANY]?

If this sounds interesting, would be happy to chat & share what we're seeing work well for our other Multimodal partners.

Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat early next week? Tuesday or Thursday PM usually open for me,

subject: Working with Viz.ai to improve diagnostic accuracy of AI models
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

With your team's recent focus on optimising your deep learning models with the growing ML team I thought I'd reach out. 

I've recently been working with Qure.ai, Subtle Medical, Viz.ai working on lesion segmentation models to improve segmentation precision and diagnostic reliability with DICOM-native annotation and validation tools. 

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: AI Human Data Leaders Dinner Invite - London
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Our CEO, [SENDER] is co-hosting an intimate gathering of Human Data Leaders with Prolific on Thursday, May 29th, and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

The event will run from 6:00 - 9:00 PM, and will include guests and experts from leading AI labs and companies including Wayve, Cohere, Runway, & Synthesia. 

We'll kick off the evening with a panel discussion focused on the new frontiers of human data and best practices in building human-in-the-loop workflows. Following the panel, we'll move into a roundtable dinner with a more informal setting for the conversation to continue.

Would you be interested in joining?

subject: Nicholas Kjaer intro - data curation / labeling
text:
Hey [NAME],

We met Nicholas at ICLR last month who mentioned that you would be
interested in a platform demo.

For context, we work with similar AV teams (including Woven, Mobileye, Oxa)
to search and visually explore multimodal datasets at the scale of billions
of items.

From our conversations with Nicholas, sounded like the most relevant areas
of interest were around surfacing interesting moments from the data (e.g.
examples of pedestrians by gender) to evidence compliance with the EU AI
Act.

*Next steps*

Suggesting some time for a platform demo on Monday 19th at 2:30 pm IST -
but we also have good availability Friday 3:30 - 5:30 pm if that works
better,

Let me know when works best & I'll update the invite accordingly,
